title: 第九章 孱弱的身体
content_zh:
雨幕渐稀，深山佛堂的寂静一如许元二人离开之时，门前尸体的血泊已经凝固。
两道身影从天而降，落在那被尸体留出的鲜血染红的空地之上。
一男一女，二人皆是一袭劲装，与地面那数十名衣着统一的尸体有着几分相似。
黑底红边，衣袍的背后用金纹绣着一条狰狞的蟠龙。
黑色劲靴踩在已经趋于凝固的血水之中，发出一阵粘稠的液态流动声。
男人一脸胡茬，背后背着一柄剑，轻佻的眸子四下看了看周围的惨状，掩住鼻子，轻轻摇了摇头：
“啧啧啧....真惨吶，看来绑走三公子的人不简单啊。”
女子面容冷峻，长发及腰，扎成一条长长高马尾飘荡在身后，腰肢纤细，胸前鼓鼓囊囊被修身劲装包裹，眸子扫过地上尸体：
“看得出来是谁做的么？”
闲庭信步般的走在尸体间，男人盯着周围的尸体，随意的摇了摇头，声音带着些许饶有兴致：
“这怎么看？全是普通剑气批斩，连剑技都没用过。”
女子眼眸微微垂下，扫视了一圈地上尸体的位置，轻声道：
“他们结过阵。”
男子点了点头：
“我知道，嗯....这些人身上的斩痕不深，都是刚好毙命，而且是一瞬间发生的。”
一瞬间?
女子闻言皱了皱眉，看着男人： “你做得到么？”
男人抬手揉了揉后脑，瞥着女子，有些好笑的说道：
“在你眼里，原来我这么不堪啊？”
顿了顿，

男人又轻轻摇了摇头，抬手指了指一具靠坐在佛堂空地上的枯井旁的尸体，眯眼笑着说道：
“不过你说的没错，我确实做不到，至少像周元这种死法，我做不到。”
话音落下，女子凝神望去。
枯井旁的尸体是一名中年男人，留着络腮胡，隔着衣服依稀可见其下虬实爆炸的肌肉，但其此刻已然双袖空空，双只小臂被齐根斩断，而致命伤是喉颈处一道细微的剑痕。
其死前的情景一目了然。
一道剑气从正门***出，作为阵眼的中年男人想用双手挡下，但剑气直接破了的护身罡气，把他的双臂砍了下来，剩余的剑气恰到好处的将其割喉而死。
没有多用一丝一毫的气力。
“我可以用一剑杀他，但像周元这样的武道高手，我做不到这么精细。”
说着，男人佯装握剑，笑呵呵的凌空对着尸体比划两下：
“我出手的话，他脑袋会直接掉下来。”
男人又微微叹了口气，瞥了一眼黑漆漆的佛堂内部，眼神幽深：
“而且里面那尊灵佛，我在不用 “源炁”的情况下，一剑斩不掉它。”..
说着，男人目露一丝凝重：
“那人可能比我强。”
女子沉默。
男人则慵懒的揉着凌乱的头发，叹了口气：
“长公子因为三公子的事已经主动从帝京赶到了靖江城，现在城里已经死了不少人，你先回去和他汇报，这次动手的人很有可能是大宗师。”
女子盯着男人，问：
“你呢？”
男人抬手摸着自己满是胡茬的下巴，咧嘴一笑：

“当然是继续追，带着三公子，就算是大宗师也跑不快。路上我会给你留记号，记得快去快回，不然等你们追上来，我可能就变尸体了~”
男人拍了拍女子的肩膀，也不等对方回应纵身一跃，直接消失在佛堂前的这片血色空地之上。
女子站在原地沉默良久，终究也化为一条残影朝着男人消失的反方向疾驰而去。
...........
两天后。
雨幕早已停息，阳光划破云层洒落，泛起一片金黄，几缕阳光透过树梢照入林间，弥漫着芳草与新鲜的泥土香味。
“哈....呼...哈..哈...”
许元插着腰扶着一旁一颗参天大树，从口中艰难的吐出两个字：
“休..休息。”
走在前方的黑衣女子闻言回头瞥了一眼他那一脸苍白的肾虚俊脸，默不作声停下了脚步，席地而坐开始闭目养神。
瞥了对方一眼，许元便直接一屁股坐在了地上，满头大汗的大喘着气。
他从未想过有人的身体能够虚成这样，更没想过这种身体会是自己的。
即便是平地，走了不过几公里，这身体的腿就开始不受控制的发颤，平稳呼吸也开始急促，一股火辣辣的感觉在胸口逐渐蔓延。
走一段路，只要稍微久一点，就能感觉后腰子里面开始隐隐作痛。
许元这三天以来有时候真的觉得，如果不是冉青墨这次抓了原身，可能完全用不了几年，原身就得死在女人肚皮上。
不禁欲也就算了，还特么不锻炼。
而且最要命的是这身体经常会传来一股类似于烟瘾，但比烟瘾要强烈无数倍的躁动感，这让许元几乎确定这位原身三公子绝对还要嗑药。
穿越并没有将身体的毛病重置到出厂设置，而且是原封不动的被许元他这倒霉蛋继承了下来。
而身体孱弱的一系列毛病，也让二人在这万兴山脉的森林中的行进速度接近龟爬。
休息间，许元的呼吸也一点点的平复了下来，看向对面闭眸养神的黑衣女子。

阳光透过树梢撒入林间，点点光斑映亮了她白皙的肌肤。
顿了顿，许元忽然出声说道：
“冉先生，以我们现在的速度，抵达天门山可能还需要一个月。”
“我知道。”冉青墨依旧闭着眸子，声线淡然。
许元略微思索，轻声道： “这样时间久了，我们随时可能会被追上。”
“.......”冉青墨没有回话，只是睁开了眼睛静静看着他。
许元略显尴尬的笑了笑。
他当然知道这些事情都是因为他这身体，但每次停下都是他坚持到身体的生理极限才休息，只是无奈这身体的极限就那么点高。
顿了顿，许元略微犹豫，轻声的建议道：
“所以，你...能否去捉一只妖兽，嗯...让我代步。”
斟酌良久，许元还是说出了这个建议。
有风险，但不大。
如果妖兽有问题，以冉青墨的实力完全可以在对方异动以前直接灭口。
冉青墨思索片刻，微微颔首，拿着剑起身，原地站立两秒，随后侧眸看向一个方向，身形瞬间消失不见。
许元愣神间，远处的一声庞然虎啸已然从千米外传来。
“嗷吼!!!!”
然后是一声闷响。
“砰！”
“吼！！！！”
“砰！”

“嗷呜......”
“砰！”
“呜呜....”
content_en:
The rain gradually thinned, and the silence of the Buddhist temple in the mountains was just like the pool of blood of the corpse in front of the door that had solidified when Xu and Yuan left.
Two figures fell from the sky and landed on the open space stained red by the blood left by the corpses.
A man and a woman, both of whom were dressed in smart clothes, were somewhat similar to the dozens of uniformly dressed corpses on the ground.
The robe is black with red edges, and a ferocious dragon is embroidered with gold patterns on the back.
The strong black boots stepped on the blood that was already solidifying, making a viscous liquid flow sound.
The man had a stubble on his face and carried a sword on his back. His frivolous eyes looked around at the miserable situation around him, he covered his nose and shook his head slightly:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk... It's so miserable. It seems that the person who kidnapped the Third Young Master is not simple."
The woman had a stern face, long hair that reached her waist, and was tied into a long high ponytail floating behind her. Her waist was slender, and her bulging chest was wrapped in a slim-fitting outfit. Her eyes swept over the corpse on the ground:
"Can you tell who did it?"
Walking leisurely among the corpses, the man stared at the corpses around him, shook his head casually, and said with a little interest in his voice:
"What do you think of this? It's all ordinary sword energy criticism and slashing, and I haven't even used any sword skills."
The woman lowered her eyes slightly, glanced around the position of the corpse on the ground, and said softly:
"They formed a team."
The man nodded:
"I know, um...the cuts on these people's bodies were not deep, they all just happened to be killed, and it happened in an instant."
A moment?
The woman frowned when she heard this and looked at the man: "Can you do it?"
The man raised his hand and rubbed the back of his head, glanced at the woman, and said amusedly:
"In your eyes, am I so unbearable?"
After a pause,
The man shook his head slightly again, raised his finger and pointed at a corpse sitting next to a dry well in the open space of the Buddhist hall, and said with a squinted smile:
"But you are right, I really can't do it, at least I can't die like Zhou Yuan."
After the words fell, the woman looked attentively.
The corpse next to the dry well was that of a middle-aged man with a beard, and the muscles under him could be vaguely seen through his clothes. However, his sleeves were empty at the moment, both forearms were cut off at the root, and the fatal injury was a slight sword mark on his throat and neck.
The scene before his death is clear.
A sword energy shot out from the front door. The middle-aged man who was the eye of the formation wanted to block it with both hands, but the sword energy directly broke the protective energy and chopped off his arms. The remaining sword energy was just right to slit his throat and kill him.
Not using any more energy.
"I can kill him with one sword, but for a martial arts master like Zhou Yuan, I can't be so precise."
As he spoke, the man pretended to hold the sword, and gestured twice at the corpse with a smile:
"If I take action, his head will fall off."
The man sighed slightly again and glanced at the dark interior of the Buddhist hall with a deep look in his eyes:
"And the spiritual Buddha inside, I can't kill it with one sword without using "Yuanqi"."...
As he spoke, the man's eyes showed a solemn expression:
"That person might be better than me."
The woman was silent.
The man lazily rubbed his messy hair and sighed:
"The eldest son has taken the initiative to rush to Jingjiang City from the Imperial Capital because of the Third Young Master's matter. Now many people have died in the city. You should go back and report to him first. The person who took action this time is most likely the Grand Master."
The woman stared at the man and asked:
"What about you?"
The man raised his hand and touched his stubble-covered chin, grinning:
"Of course, keep chasing. Even the Grand Master can't run fast with the Third Young Master. I will leave a mark for you on the way. Remember to go back quickly, otherwise I may turn into a corpse when you catch up~"
The man patted the woman on the shoulder, jumped up without waiting for her response, and disappeared directly into the bloody open space in front of the Buddhist hall.
The woman stood there in silence for a long time, and finally turned into an afterimage and moved towardsThe man sped away in the opposite direction where he disappeared.
...........
Two days later.
The rain has long since stopped, and the sun breaks through the clouds, casting a golden glow. A few rays of sunlight shine through the treetops into the forest, filling the air with the scent of fragrant grass and fresh earth.
"Ha...hu...ha...ha..."
Xu Yuan leaned on his waist and supported a towering tree beside him, and uttered two words with difficulty:
"Hugh.. rest."
The woman in black who was walking in front looked back and glanced at his handsome face with pale kidneys. She stopped silently, sat on the ground and began to close her eyes and meditate.
After glancing at the other party, Xu Yuan sat down on the ground, sweating profusely and panting.
He never thought that someone's body could become like this, let alone that this body could be his own.
Even on flat ground, after walking only a few kilometers, the legs of this body began to tremble uncontrollably, the steady breathing began to become rapid, and a burning feeling gradually spread in the chest.
After walking for a while, you can feel a dull pain in your lower back.
In the past three days, Xu Yuan sometimes really felt that if Ran Qingmo hadn't captured the original body this time, the original body would have died on the woman's belly in less than a few years.
It’s okay if you don’t abstain from sex, and you don’t even exercise.
And the most terrible thing is that this body often has a restless feeling similar to the craving for cigarettes, but countless times stronger than the craving for cigarettes. This makes Xu Yuan almost certain that the original Third Young Master must also take drugs.
The time travel did not reset the body's problems to the factory settings, and they were inherited intact by Xu Yuan, the unlucky guy.
A series of physical ailments also made the two of them move at a speed close to that of a tortoise in the forest of the Wanxing Mountains.
During the rest, Xu Yuan's breathing calmed down little by little, and he looked at the woman in black opposite him who closed his eyes to rest.
The sun shines through the treetops into the forest, and the spots of light illuminate her fair skin.
After a pause, Xu Yuan suddenly said:
"Mr. Ran, at our current speed, it may take another month to reach Tianmen Mountain."
"I know." Ran Qingmo still closed his eyes and said in a calm voice.
Xu Yuan thought for a moment and said softly: "If this goes on for a long time, we may be overtaken at any time."
"..." Ran Qingmo didn't reply, just opened his eyes and looked at him quietly.
Xu Yuan smiled slightly awkwardly.
Of course he knew that these things were all because of his body, but every time he stopped, he insisted on reaching the physiological limit of his body before resting, but it was helpless that his body's limit was just that high.
After a pause, Xu Yuan hesitated slightly and suggested softly:
"So, can you...could you catch a monster? Well...let me do it for you."
After deliberation for a long time, Xu Yuan finally came up with this suggestion.
There is a risk, but not much.
If there is a problem with the monster, Ran Qingmo's strength can completely kill it before it makes any move.
Ran Qingmo thought for a moment, nodded slightly, stood up with the sword, stood there for two seconds, then looked sideways in one direction, and disappeared in an instant.
Xu Yuan was stunned when a huge tiger roar came from a thousand meters away.
"Ouch!!!!"
Then there was a muffled sound.
"Bang!"
"Roar!!!"
"Bang!"
"Ouch..."
"Bang!"
"Woooo..."
